column1: # The frozen SHORT questions (hivemind-4fzjf): questions of two or three words that matter, each using a word of
# `WORD_GROUPS` (src/queries/terms.rs) in its everyday sense where a decision's title and topic keys say the stand-in:
# the cafe's rebrand against the decision about renaming the website, the school presentation against "Pitch deck", the
# rival team against the competitor check. In a question that short one whole word already met the bar of half the
# words (183cb447, 39f0f658); strays.tsv, whose questions run six to nine words, could not see it. DO NOT EDIT ROWS: a
# build is judged by running this set next to questions.tsv and strays.tsv. A new set is a new file; this one stays.
# Rows: 24 hand-written for the bead (4fzjf:S01-S24) and the product check's short rows ST1-ST13 (dog-183cb447;
# ST14-ST18 are older groups and direct words that master 45f15984 already answered, so they are not here), all STRAY.
# Then four SYNONYM rows that ask ABOUT the thing and must keep finding it (4fzjf:P1-P4): the question names the
# decision's subject and a second word the decision holds (the docs example, a question about the investor presentation,
# names no word the ledger holds besides the stand-in, so it is a stray row of this class, not a positive).
# Columns (tab separated): id, kind, expect, question, role.
#   id      dog-<build>:<id> for a question the product check filed, 4fzjf:<id> for one written for the bead.
#   kind    STRAY: a question about nothing the ledger holds. It FAILS when `why` lists or answers a decision, or
#           `recall` returns any. SYNONYM: asks about a decision in other words; it FAILS when recall misses it.
#   expect  `none` for STRAY; for SYNONYM the 8-character id prefix of the decision (`|` between alternatives).
#   role    `fail` = 39f0f658 listed a decision for this row where master 45f15984 listed nothing, on the crew copy
#           or the cell-sized copy; `guard` = it did not. The SYNONYM rows are guards.
# Ledger copies it was measured on, both taken 2026-10-23: the crew ledger (534 events) and a copy of the live cell
